name: reminders
description: To-do list that pops up on your PC and sends reminders to your phone through Telegram

APP_KEY.description: Choose a password for your app (8+ characters). You'll type it once on each device.

TELEGRAM_TOKEN.description: Your Telegram bot token. In Telegram, message @BotFather, send /newbot, and copy the token it gives you (looks like 123456789:AAH...).

TZ.description: Your time zone, e.g. Asia/Riyadh, Asia/Dubai, Africa/Cairo.

DB.description: Where your tasks are stored. The default name is fine.
